storyCards.headline: I Love Rock 'n Roll: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Joan Jett's "I Love Rock 'n Roll" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 20 weeks on the chart.

I Love Rock 'n Roll was released in 1982.

Chart story — peaked at #1 on the Hot 100.
